stateContract.draftInput: Every input event invokes native change/save to assign S.notes[ID].draft. This is draft persistence, not explicit collection.
stateContract.explicitSave: Nonempty draft.trim() and raw draft.length <=5000 required. Successful native save writes submitted=draft.trim(), at=Date.now(); draft remains.
stateContract.oversize: Native textarea has no maxlength. Oversize draft still persists through input. Explicit collection rejects it via global native status. Do not silently truncate or invent a new limit.
stateContract.reload: Initial restoreNotes restores draft text for every data-note-input ID. It does not reconstruct a per-note saved status sentence; initial status remains generic until interaction.
stateContract.allMyWork: Only notes with nonempty submitted render. Last explicitly saved response appears; if draft.trim()!=submitted, a newer-draft notice appears. C.notes title used if registered, otherwise raw ID.
stateContract.history: Notes store current draft plus last submitted text and timestamp. They do not append practice attempts to S.history. Saving again replaces the last submitted note. Do not promise an attempt ledger or first-try grading.
stateContract.progress: Required progress counts S.history kind=check only. Notes do not count toward required checks.
stateContract.failure: Native change/save clone, revision checking, blocked state, cross-tab event and storage error handling remain owners. No bypass/direct storage writer is permitted.
stateContract.print: Existing All My Work print flow includes collected notes. Static-source inference only; print/reload/save tests pending.
stateContract.namespace: Existing biology30-chapter-17:html:v1 or native LMS-scoped key; do not add a namespace or storage schema.
stateContract.hintAndModelState: Ordinary details/summary toggles are not recorded as hint-use or first-try state. No such tracking is claimed.

modelComparisonContract.hint: Use ordinary native details/summary for an intentional optional hint. Include all needed task stimulus before the response.
modelComparisonContract.model: Use a separate ordinary native details/summary for full model, criteria and explanatory feedback. Author instruction may ask learner to save first, then compare.
modelComparisonContract.saveGate: No generic S.notes model-unlock mechanism exists. Do not set data-locked=true: it would never unlock for a new note. data-extension-model queries only the first matching element and is hardcoded to ch17-optional-extension.
modelComparisonContract.honestUIStatement: Comparison is learner-controlled, not technically save-gated. If enforced save-gating is required later, it is a new runtime change requiring a separate integration decision and tests; not part of this teaching-only proposal.
